Provides a resource to create a BH resource

> **NOTE:** Currently, executing the `terraform destroy` command to delete this resource is not supported. If you need to destroy it, please contact Tencent Cloud BH through a ticket.

import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

    vpcId: "vpc-q1of50wz",
    subnetId: "subnet-7uhvm46o",
    resourceEdition: "standard",
    resourceNode: 20,
    timeUnit: "m",
    timeSpan: 1,
    payMode: 1,
    autoRenewFlag: 1,
    deployZone: "ap-guangzhou-6",
    cidrBlock: "192.168.11.0/24",
    vpcCidrBlock: "192.168.0.0/16",
    intranetAccess: 1,
    externalAccess: 1,
});

## Import



BH resource can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Bh/resource:Resource example bh-saas-sada9k
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
